messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm proposing we pivot the current `metrics_index_v1` to a compact, SLA-aware shape next week. Want to outline a minimal, rollback-safe plan here.
kevin: +1. What's the core shape change?
sara: Curious about read perf impact; will dashboards need changes?
maria: Two main changes: 1) collapse per-route tags into a single `route_id` FK col, 2) add `sla_bucket` enum and precompute p95/p99 counters. Should cut index bloat.
jon: Sounds good. How will this affect quota calc and console rollups?
maria: Plan: shadow write to `metrics_index_v2` for 48h, mirror reads for 10% of console traffic. Quota service continues reading v1 until cutover. We'll run a reconciliation job nightly.
kevin: Reconciliation details? edge cases?
maria: We'll run this job:
```sql
INSERT INTO metrics_index_v2 (route_id, ts, sla_bucket, p95_tokens)
SELECT route_id, ts_bucket, compute_sla(route_tags), approx_p95(tokens)
FROM metrics_index_v1
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
ON CONFLICT (route_id, ts) DO UPDATE SET p95_tokens = EXCLUDED.p95_tokens;
```
kevin: Nice. compute_sla() will map existing quota tiers -> sla_bucket? Need mapping table.
sara: Dashboard changes: we should keep UI polyfill for both shapes during canary. Add an adapter in console-read layer `read_metrics(route_id, start, end)` that queries v2 then falls back to v1.
jon: Can we avoid double counting in billing during shadow write?
maria: Shadow writes must be flagged; billing pipeline reads only v1 until we flip a feature flag. Ops-bot: deploy scheduled: metrics-indexer v2 -> canary at 2026-04-02T03:00Z :package:
kevin: Performance test checklist?
maria: Run bulk backfill on a sandbox cluster with production-ish data (50M rows). Measure write amplification, index sizes, p99 read latencies for dashboard queries. If p99 increases > 20% we abort.
sara: Backfill safety: add a slow-continue switch so we can pause the backfill and resume without overlaps.
jon: Migration cutover steps (draft):
1) deploy indexer + read adapter (dark reads)
2) shadow-write 48h, nightly reconciliations for 7 days
3) run query parity tests for key dashboards (automated)
4) flip console feature flag to prefer v2 reads for 10% -> 50% -> 100%
5) flip billing to v2 after 24h at 100%
6) cleanup v1 after 30 days
maria: Agree. Also add canary rollback: if discrepancy > 0.5% or any SLA regression, flip reads back and pause writes.
kevin: Who owns the reconciliation monitor?
maria: I'll own initial alerts, but tagging infra oncall: @jon for pager.
jon: ack. I'll add an integration alert: `metrics.index.parity` with thresholds and a dashboard.
sara: Small note: add migration docs in console repo + a migration-runbook snippet with commands to pause/resume backfill.
maria: Will add.
kevin: LGTM. One last ask: can we compress `route_id` as int32 to save space? storage team?
maria: Yes — we'll use route mapping service to produce compact ids during backfill. I'll coordinate with storage team.
ops-bot: Job scheduled: nightly-reconcile starting 2026-04-02, owner: maria, watch: jon
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks everyone — I'll push the PR with the adapter and runbook today.
